title: The Quran: Surah 114, an-Nas (Mankind)
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 114. O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: Which titles does the speaker give in verses 1 to 3?
options: Lord, King and God of mankind
questions.why: Os versículos 1, 2 e 3 dizem: 'Lord of mankind', 'King of mankind' e 'God of mankind'.

questions.q: What does verse 5 suggest about how the whisperer acts?
questions.why: O versículo 5 diz que ele sussurra 'into the hearts of people', e 'sneaky' reforça a ideia de algo escondido.

questions.q: Which two words repeat in verses 1, 2 and 3?
questions.why: Os três primeiros versículos terminam em 'of mankind'.

questions.q: According to verse 6, who can the whisperer be?
questions.why: O versículo 6 diz: 'From among jinn and among people.'

B2.discussion: The speaker uses three different titles for the same one he takes refuge in. Why might a text repeat 'of mankind' three times?
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Say who the speaker takes refuge in and what he wants protection from.

questions.q: What does the whisperer do, according to verse 5?
options: He whispers into the hearts of people
questions.why: O versículo 5 diz: 'Who whispers into the hearts of people.'

questions.q: What does the adjective 'sneaky' add to 'whisperer'?
options: A sense of hidden, quiet action
A sense of a large size
questions.why: 'Sneaky' descreve algo que actua às escondidas, o que combina com sussurrar.

questions.q: Why might the text say 'into the hearts' and not 'into the ears'?
options: To show that the whisper reaches the inside of people
To say the whisperer cannot speak
To say the whisperer is far away
To say the whisperer is a child
questions.why: 'Hearts' aponta para o interior das pessoas.

questions.q: What happens at verse 4 in the structure of the passage?
options: The titles end and the danger begins
questions.why: Os versículos 1 a 3 dão títulos; o versículo 4 começa com 'From the evil of' e nomeia o perigo.

questions.q: Which statement is best supported by the text?
options: Three titles come first, and then one danger is named
One title comes first, and then three dangers
questions.why: Há três títulos (versículos 1 a 3) e um único perigo, o 'sneaky whisperer' (versículos 4 a 6).

C1.discussion: The passage builds three titles before naming the danger. How does this order affect the way the reader experiences the request for refuge?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how the passage is organised, from verse 1 to verse 6.

glossary: from among jinn and among people
de entre jinn e de entre pessoas

questions.q: What does verse 6 add to the description of the whisperer?
options: It says he comes from among jinn and among people
It says he is a king
It says he is a stranger
questions.why: O versículo 6 fecha a descrição com 'From among jinn and among people.'

questions.q: In 'whispers into the hearts', the preposition 'into' suggests:
options: entering a space, the inside of people
questions.why: 'Into' dá a ideia de entrar, e o que se atinge é o interior das pessoas.

questions.q: What effect does the three-part sequence 'Lord... King... God of mankind' have?
options: It builds up a repeated pattern before the danger is named
questions.why: A repetição de 'of mankind' três vezes cria um padrão que prepara a entrada do perigo no versículo 4.

questions.q: How does verse 6 relate to verses 4 and 5?
options: It specifies where the whisperer comes from
questions.why: O versículo 6 acrescenta uma especificação aos versículos 4 e 5.

questions.q: Which description of the passage is best supported?
options: Three titles, then one danger described in three verses
A story with a beginning, middle and end
questions.why: Versículos 1 a 3: títulos. Versículos 4 a 6: o perigo, com nome, acção e origem.

C2.discussion: The passage names a danger that acts quietly and from within. How do the words 'sneaky', 'whispers' and 'hearts' work together to create that impression?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how repetition and structure shape the passage, referring to specific words in verses 1 to 6.
